posts.body_html: I think you're onto something Kiwiearl!  Didn't notice it before, but I definitely see it now!  I also like how S. jonesii behaves similarly with respect to red pigment formation.  At first, the pitchers in the spring are boring, and as the summer progresses, some clones can turn "ornate" and eventually deep red.
